validity.recommendation: Do not add refs as-is; review for merge/retirement against P1864 (Khoms-Tripoli Gas Pipeline, 201 km) + P1865 (Tripoli-Mellitah Gas Pipeline, 158 km), which already fully cover the Khoms->Mellitah route. Flag to Baird as a likely duplicate/digitization-artifact row rather than a real standalone 25 km pipe.
validity.researcher_notes: Both of the wiki page's own citations are dead and neither actually names a standalone 'Khoms-Melita' pipeline. (1) 'Natural Gas Pipelines in Europe, Asia, Africa & Middle East', Harvard worldmap.harvard.edu/data/geonode:natural_gas_pipelines_j96 -> now 404 (verified with url_verifier), and even when live this was a generic global pipeline-map dataset, not a source that names this specific pipeline -- exactly the kind of aggregate citation the task flags as an existence red flag. (2) sirteoil.com.ly/?p=8754 -> the live site has been rebuilt as a JS SPA that serves only a blank shell for this old query-string URL (confirmed 200 but empty content, no article); the Wayback snapshot (archive timestamp 2021-06-19, verified live and containing the expected Arabic terms) recovers the original article, which is a tour report by Sirte Oil Co's board chairman of western-region gas facilities. Crucially, that source does NOT describe a 'Khoms-Melita' pipeline as a discrete object -- it explicitly names the route as two separate lines, quote: "خط 'الخمس - طرابلس' 'طرابلس - مليتة' تم تشغيله مبكراً..." (the 'Khoms-Tripoli' / 'Tripoli-Mellitah' line was commissioned early...), i.e. the exact same segment names GEM already tracks separately as P1864 (Khoms-Tripoli, 201 km) and P1865 (Tripoli-Mellitah, 158 km). The article does use an informal umbrella phrase 'الخط الطولي الخمس مليته' (the Khoms-Mellitah longitudinal line) for job titles/administrative purposes (e.g. 'منسق العمليات والخط الطولي الخمس مليته'), confirming Sirte Oil Co. operates this corridor as a unit -- which supports Operator=Sirte Oil Co as plausible -- but gives no support for a physically distinct 25 km segment called 'Khoms-Melita'. Geographically, Khoms and the Mellitah Complex are roughly 220 km apart by straight line (and ~360 km by the P1864+P1865 route length, consistent with a coastal detour through Tripoli); a 25 km pipeline cannot span that distance, so this cannot be read as a shorthand/simplified version of the same route. I could find zero independent sources (web search in English and Arabic) that describe a distinct 'Khoms-Melita'/'Khoms-Mellitah' pipeline with a 25 km length, 34-inch diameter, or 2 bcm/y capacity -- every hit either is GEM's own wiki page or is unrelated. GEM's own separately-cited Libya Coastal Gas Pipeline page (read for structural context only, not cited here) describes the same Khoms-to-Mellitah stretch as the 'western segment' of that single 1164 km trunk (nominal 600 mmcf/day), reinforcing that this corridor is already modeled elsewhere in the dataset (P0483 in aggregate; P1864+P1865 at segment level) and that P1789's very short 25 km / 2 bcm/y figures do not correspond to any documented physical asset. Net: existence of *a* Khoms-Mellitah gas corridor is real, but the specific object recorded under P1789 (a standalone 25 km, 34in, 2 bcm/y line) looks like a duplicate/fragment -- most plausibly a mis-scoped or badly digitized artifact from the (now-dead) Harvard worldmap dataset -- rather than a distinct physical pipeline. Location field is also internally inconsistent: EndState/Province is populated with 'Melita Port', which is not a real Libyan province (the real province for Mellitah is Nuqat al Khams, as recorded correctly on P0483/P0484), another sign this row was carelessly assembled.

summary: P1789 'Khoms-Melita Pipeline' (25 km) has two dead source citations, no independent confirmation of a standalone 25 km line, and the only recoverable independent source (archived Sirte Oil Co. article) describes this exact corridor as the already-separately-tracked 'Khoms-Tripoli' (P1864) + 'Tripoli-Mellitah' (P1865) segments -- flagged as a likely duplicate/digitization artifact, not a real distinct pipeline.
